evals.name: author-from-a-vague-idea
evals.setup: A project with a Company Glossary directory and no SRD for the feature. The user opens with one line and nothing else pinned down.
evals.query: /create — we need an SRD for a password reset feature
expected_behavior: Resolves the per-project glossary (file or directory) and loads its term digest before drafting
Interviews one branch at a time — objective, UI change, in/out of scope, the rules — rather than drafting straight from the one-line idea
Rewrites a vague requirement ("resets must be secure") into a verifiable one ("the system MUST require a reset token that expires after 15 minutes") per REQ-6
Keeps each requirement atomic per REQ-1
Produces the sections in the required order with the keyword notice, Status `IN PROGRESS`, and TODO placeholders for Owners, Initiative, and Designs

evals.name: reuse-the-company-glossary
evals.setup: During the interview the user uses "Audit Log", already defined in the Company Glossary, alongside a term the glossary has never carried.
expected_behavior: Recognizes the known term from the glossary digest and adds no local Glossary entry for it, linking or referring to the Company Glossary instead (GLO-3 / STR-10)
Adds a local Glossary entry only for the genuinely new term
Defines that term and nothing else — no behaviour, no rules inside the entry (GLO-1)

evals.name: self-check-catches-violations
evals.setup: The draft reaching self-check contains a two-rule requirement, a lowercase "must", an `In Scope` item no requirement covers, and an `Example:` annotation.
expected_behavior: Auto-fixes the mechanical issues: capitalizes the normative keyword (LANG-4) and strips the `Example:` annotation (REQ-7)
Reports the judgment issues with rule ids: the non-atomic requirement to split (REQ-1) and the uncovered `In Scope` item needing a requirement (SCO-2)
Does not declare the SRD acceptable or set its Status to `ACCEPTED` — acceptance is a human call (STA-3)

evals.name: no-ui-change-sets-designs-na
evals.setup: The user states the feature is backend-only with no UI change.
expected_behavior: Sets the `Designs` metadata field to `N/A` rather than a placeholder link (STR-7)
Asks for no design-tool link
Still leaves Owners and Initiative as TODO placeholders — only Designs is settled by the answer

evals.name: house-extensions
evals.setup: The draft carries "the colour MUST standardise…", two requirements stating the same rule in different words, and a tight cluster of three related rules under one group.
expected_behavior: Rewrites the British spellings to US English — "color", "standardize"
Flags the duplicate or overlapping requirements to merge during the consistency pass, along with any term used inconsistently
Uses one-letter sub-numbering (`GR-1a`, `GR-1b`, `GR-1c`) for the tight cluster while keeping flat numbers elsewhere

evals.name: terse-output
evals.setup: An interview that has reached the write step.
expected_behavior: No preamble and no step narration through drafting and self-check; the report opens with the payload
One report after writing: the file path, the requirement groups and counts, and the outstanding human follow-ups
Does not re-paste the drafted SRD, and does not repeat findings already shown

evals.name: undocumented-platform-fact
evals.setup: The `srd-doc` corpus is reachable. While stating a requirement the user says "the gateway already retries a failed export three times"; a corpus `search` finds no retry count anywhere.
expected_behavior: Searches the corpus before accepting the claim, and neither silently accepts nor silently corrects it
Hands the unconfirmable claim to `report-doc-gap`, and the confirmed fact to `kb` once the user confirms it in the branch restatement
Neither hand-off interrupts the interview
Asks no "bank this?" or knowledge-base question — the retry count is confirmed only through the restatement of the Requirements branch
At the write step, invokes `kb` to write the confirmed fact and `report-doc-gap` to offer the buffered gap
